abstract: Between December 1986 and December 1988, the Italian Cooperative Group on AIDS-Related Tumours documented 49 HIV-related tumours other than malignant lymphomas (ML) and Kaposi's sarcomas (KS), predominantly among HIV-infected intravenous drug abusers (IVDA). Of 12 germinal testicular tumours collected, six were seminomas, two of which were pure embryonal and the other four embryonal mixed. Cervical carcinoma was observed in nine IVDAs (intraepithelial in eight and advanced, with rapid progression, in one). Lung cancer associated with HIV infection was reported in eight patients, of whom four had an adenocarcinoma, two a small cell carcinoma, one an epidermoid carcinoma and one a mesothelioma. All patients with non-small-cell-lung cancer (SCLC) were at stage III, while those with SCLC and mesothelioma had limited disease. Five out of eight presented with limited disease at onset. The median age was low; lung cancer occurred predominantly in young adults, of whom all but one were smokers. Three patients could not be treated; four died while on treatment because of progression of the neoplasia and one died of an overdose. Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) was diagnosed in five patients. The immunophenotype was always Burkitt-like (L3), and acute myeloblastic leukaemia (M2) was diagnosed in one. Of the central nervous system (CNS) tumours, two cases of glioblastoma and one of medulloblastoma were described. Two cases of young adults with multiple myeloma and two cases of colorectal carcinoma were also reported. One case of chronic lymphocytic leukaemia, one anorectal carcinoma, one oral carcinoma, one pancreatic carcinoma, one thymoma, one kidney carcinoma, one malignant melanoma and thyroid carcinoma were also found.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 1986年12月から1988年12月の間に、イタリアのAIDS関連腫瘍協同研究グループは、リンパ腫（ML）とカポジ肉腫（KS）を除くHIV関連腫瘍49例を記録した。その大半は静注薬物乱用者（IVDA）であった。収集した精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例のうち、セミノーマが6例で、そのうち2例は純粋な胎児性癌、残る4例は胎児性癌を含む混合型であった。子宮頸癌は9例のIVDAで認められ、8例は上皮内癌、1例は進行例で急速に進行した。HIV感染に関連した肺癌は8例で報告され、4例は腺癌、2例は小細胞癌、1例は扁平上皮癌、1例は中皮腫であった。非小細胞肺癌の全例はステージIIIであり、小細胞癌および中皮腫の症例は限局病変であった。肺癌の8例中5例は発症時に限局病変であった。発症時の年齢の中央値は低く、肺癌は主に若年成人に発生し、そのうち1例を除き全例が喫煙者であった。3例は治療不能、4例は治療中に腫瘍の進行により死亡し、1例は薬物の過量摂取で死亡した。急性リンパ性白血病（ALL）は5例で診断され、免疫表現型は常にBurkitt様（L3）であった。急性骨髄性白血病（M2）は1例で診断された。中枢神経系腫瘍のうち、膠芽腫2例と髄芽腫1例が記述された。若年成人の多発性骨髄腫2例と大腸癌2例も報告された。慢性リンパ性白血病1例、肛門直腸癌1例、口腔癌1例、膵癌1例、胸腺腫1例、腎癌1例、悪性黒色腫1例、甲状腺癌も認められた。
